rate_limits: New accounts start at 2 concurrent IN_PROGRESS requests globally; paid credit purchases scale the self-serve limit up to 40. Excess requests queue, and endpoint-specific caps may apply.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Replace original; fal publishes concurrency limits, including the 2-request default, scaling to 40, queuing, and possible endpoint caps: https://fal.ai/docs/documentation/model-apis/concurrency-limits. cors: Set to yes; fal's official browser client is designed for direct browser use, while a proxy is recommended to protect API keys: https://github.com/fal-ai/fal-js and https://fal.ai/docs/documentation/model-apis/inference/server-side.
